title: Hoisting the Hurricane’s American Flag
description: As a sign of appreciation for their commitment to the United States, the Carolina Hurricanes sent the 30th Armored Brigade Combat Team, assigned to Multinational Battle Group-East, currently in Kosovo on Camp Bondsteel, an American flag to be flown over Bondsteel for 24 hours and sent back to the Hurricanes.
